# LindbladSolver { #clerq.LindbladSolver }

```python
LindbladSolver(
    system=None,
    t_min=0.0,
    t_max=1.0,
    t_steps=100,
    method='mesolve',
    opts=None,
    savefile=None,
    *,
    atom=None,
)
```

Time-domain master equation solver for a single spatial point.

Wraps :func:`qutip.mesolve` to evolve the density matrix of a
:class:`~clerq.system.System` over a user-defined time grid, and can
save/load results to avoid recomputation.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type         | Description                                                                                                            | Default     |
|----------|--------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| system   | dict \| None | Dict (or empty dict for defaults) describing the quantum system; passed to :class:`~clerq.system.System`.              | `None`      |
| t_min    | float        | Start time of the simulation.                                                                                          | `0.0`       |
| t_max    | float        | End time of the simulation.                                                                                            | `1.0`       |
| t_steps  | int          | Number of time steps.                                                                                                  | `100`       |
| method   | str          | Solver method — ``'mesolve'`` (Lindblad master equation) is the only supported value.                                  | `'mesolve'` |
| opts     | dict \| None | Dict of QuTiP solver options passed to ``qutip.Options``.                                                              | `None`      |
| savefile | str \| None  | Path prefix for caching solved results (``'.qu'`` extension appended automatically). Pass ``None`` to disable caching. | `None`      |
| atom     | dict \| None | Deprecated name for ``system``.                                                                                        | `None`      |

### build_opts { #clerq.LindbladSolver.build_opts }

```python
LindbladSolver.build_opts(opts=None)
```

Build the options dict to be passed into the QuTiP solver.

Any option available to the QuTiP solver is available here, we
provide defaults for solving the optical Bloch equations. See [0]
for details of all the available options.

#### Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

- For a stiff problem, it may help to set 'method' to
    'bdf' instead of 'adams'.
- If the solver times out, try more 'nsteps', though
    this will take longer.
- To speed up the solver, reduce atol and rtol, though this
    will reduce accuracy.

#### Warning {.doc-section .doc-section-warning}

There is no validation checking here. If you pass in an option
which is not known to QuTiP it will throw an exception.

[0]: http://qutip.org/docs/4.2/guide/dynamics/dynamics-options.html

### set_field_rabi_freq_t_args { #clerq.LindbladSolver.set_field_rabi_freq_t_args }

```python
LindbladSolver.set_field_rabi_freq_t_args(field_idx, t_args)
```

Set the Rabi frequency time function arguments. To be used with

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type   | Description                                          | Default    |
|-----------|--------|------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| field_idx | int    | The field for which to set the Rabi frequency t_args | _required_ |

### set_field_rabi_freq_t_func { #clerq.LindbladSolver.set_field_rabi_freq_t_func }

```python
LindbladSolver.set_field_rabi_freq_t_func(field_idx, t_func)
```

Set the Rabi frequency time function of a field to a new time
    function. This is useful when you want to set a custom function,
    not one available in t_funcs.py

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type   | Description                                          | Default    |
|-----------|--------|------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| field_idx | int    | The field for which to set the Rabi frequency t_func | _required_ |
| t_func    | Any    | Rabi frequency as a function of time, f(t, args)     | _required_ |

### solve { #clerq.LindbladSolver.solve }

```python
LindbladSolver.solve(
    e_ops=None,
    opts=None,
    recalc=True,
    show_pbar=False,
    save=True,
)
```

Solves the Lindblad master equation for the system.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type         | Description                                                   | Default   |
|-----------|--------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| e_ops     | list \| None | Expectation value operators passed to the QuTiP solver.       | `None`    |
| opts      | dict \| None | QuTiP solver options, overriding those set at initialisation. | `None`    |
| recalc    | bool         | Recalculate the solution even if a savefile exists?           | `True`    |
| show_pbar | bool         | Show the QuTiP text progress bar.                             | `False`   |
| save      | bool         | Save the result to ``savefile``, if one is set.               | `True`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                   |
|--------|------------|-----------------------------------------------|
|        | np.ndarray | The solved density matrix at each time, shape |
|        | np.ndarray | (t_steps+1, num_states, num_states).          |
